identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Pegilodecakin (LY3500518) With FOLFOX Compared to FOLFOX Alone Second-line Tx in Participants With Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Randomized Study of AM0010 in Combination With FOLFOX Compared to FOLFOX Alone as Second-line Tx in Pts With Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer That Has Progressed During or Following a First-Line Gemcitabine Containing Regimen

armGroups.label: Pegilodecakin + FOLFOX
armGroups.description: Pegilodecakin 5 microgram per kilogram (μg/kg) dosed as one of the following 2 fixed doses: 0.4 milligram (mg) for participants weighing ≤80 kg or 0.8 mg for participants weighing\>80 kg on Days 1-5 and Days 8-12 subcutaneously (SC) plus FOLFOX \[dl-Leucovorin (dl-LV) 400 milligram per meter square (mg/m2) and oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2 followed by bolus 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) 400 mg/m2 and a 46 to 48 hour infusion of 5- FU 2400 mg/m2\] initiated on Day 1 of a 14-day cycles for up to 12 cycles or until disease progression. After discontinuation of FOLFOX in the absence of tumor progression \[that is (i.e., completion of the planned 12 cycles or unacceptable FOLFOX related toxicity\], Pegilodecakin 10µg/kg maintenance treatment administered as one of the 2 fixed doses, either 0.8 mg for participants weighing ≤80 kg or 1.6 mg for participants weighing\>80 kg.

armGroups.label: FOLFOX
armGroups.description: FOLFOX (dl-LV 400 mg/m2 and oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2 followed by bolus 5-FU 400 mg/m2 and a 46-hour infusion of 5-FU 2400 mg/m2) initiated on Day 1 of a 14-day cycles for up to 12 cycles or until disease progression.
